```{r, warning=F, message=F}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)


# 13.1 Import Data


data_dir <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Gene/data"
raw_data_dir <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/raw_data"
results_dir <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Gene/results"

# Gene matrix
full_vsd <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "vst_full.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors = F,
  check.names = F,
  row.names = 1
) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene")

# ENSG -> gene symbol mapping
ensg2gene <- read.csv(
  file.path(raw_data_dir, "host_gene_counts.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors = F
) %>%
  { setNames(.$gene_symbol, .$X) }

full_vsd <- full_vsd %>%
  mutate(
    gene_symbol = ensg2gene[gene],
    gene_symbol = ifelse(
      is.na(gene_symbol),
      gene,
      gene_symbol
    )
  )

# Protein matrix
protein_mat <- read.csv(
  file.path(
    "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Prot/data",
    "protein_mat.csv"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = F,
  check.names = F
)

# LASSO fold coefficients: gene workflow
lasso_coefs_gene <- read.csv(
  file.path(
    results_dir,
    "lasso_fold_coefs.csv"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = F
)

# LASSO fold coefficients: protein workflow
lasso_coefs_prot <- read.csv(
  file.path(
    "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Prot/results",
    "lasso_fold_coefs.csv"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = F
)

# Metadata
metadata_df <- read.csv(
  file.path(
    data_dir,
    "metadata_df_with_folds.csv"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = F
)


# 13.2 Plot settings


plot_width <- 6.5
plot_height <- 6.5

plot_font <- "Arial"
plot_font_size <- 12

genes_biomarker <- c(
  "FABP4",
  "ISG15",
  "IFIT2",
  "IFIT3",
  "APOE",
  "SLAMF7",
  "OLAH"
)

shared_genes <- intersect(
  full_vsd$gene_symbol,
  colnames(protein_mat)[-1]
)

cat(
  "Shared analytes:",
  length(shared_genes),
  "\n"
)


# 13.3 Compute per-analyte Pearson r


cor_per_gene <- full_vsd %>%
  filter(gene_symbol %in% shared_genes) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(gene, gene_symbol),
    names_to = "sample_name",
    values_to = "expr_rna"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    metadata_df %>%
      select(
        sample_name,
        patient_id
      ),
    by = "sample_name"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    protein_mat %>%
      { colnames(.)[1] <- "patient_id"; . } %>%
      mutate(
        patient_id = as.integer(patient_id)
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = -patient_id,
        names_to = "gene_symbol",
        values_to = "expr_protein"
      ) %>%
      filter(gene_symbol %in% shared_genes),
    by = c(
      "patient_id",
      "gene_symbol"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
  summarize(
    pearson_r = cor.test(
      expr_rna,
      expr_protein,
      method = "pearson"
    )$estimate,
    p_value = cor.test(
      expr_rna,
      expr_protein,
      method = "pearson"
    )$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    padj = p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  )

summary(cor_per_gene$pearson_r)

# Biomarker concordance p-values
cor_per_gene %>%
  filter(
    gene_symbol %in% genes_biomarker
  ) %>%
  select(
    gene_symbol,
    pearson_r,
    p_value,
    padj
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(pearson_r))


# 13.4 Identify LASSO-selected analytes


genes_lasso <- unique(
  c(
    lasso_coefs_gene$gene_symbol,
    lasso_coefs_prot$protein
  )
)

cor_per_gene <- cor_per_gene %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      gene_symbol %in% genes_biomarker ~ "Biomarker",
      gene_symbol %in% genes_lasso ~ "LASSO-selected",
      TRUE ~ "Background"
    )
  )


# 13.5 Main density plot of per-analyte Pearson r


median_r <- median(
  cor_per_gene$pearson_r,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

p_density <- ggplot(
  cor_per_gene,
  aes(x = pearson_r)
) +
  geom_density(
    fill = "#4C72B0",
    alpha = 0.25,
    color = "grey25",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "solid",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = median_r,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = median_r + 0.03,
    y = Inf,
    label = paste0(
      "Median r = ",
      round(median_r, 3)
    ),
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1.5,
    size = 3.5,
    family = plot_font
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-0.5, 0.9),
    breaks = seq(-0.4, 0.8, 0.2)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "RNA-protein concordance across shared analytes",
    x = "Pearson r (RNA vs protein)",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = plot_font_size,
    base_family = plot_font
  ) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(
      family = plot_font,
      size = plot_font_size
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "plain"
    ),
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "plain",
      size = plot_font_size
    ),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

print(p_density)

ggsave(
  file.path(
    results_dir,
    "correlation_density_plot.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_density,
  width = plot_width,
  height = plot_height,
  device = cairo_pdf
)


# 13.6 Print LASSO overlap information


cat(
  "LASSO genes that are also biomarkers:",
  sum(
    genes_lasso %in% genes_biomarker
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "LASSO genes in shared analytes:",
  sum(
    genes_lasso %in% cor_per_gene$gene_symbol
  ),
  "\n"
)


# 13.7 Compute per-analyte Pearson r by LRTI group


cor_per_gene_adj <- full_vsd %>%
  filter(
    gene_symbol %in% shared_genes
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(gene, gene_symbol),
    names_to = "sample_name",
    values_to = "expr_rna"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    metadata_df %>%
      select(
        sample_name,
        patient_id,
        LRTI_adjudication
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        LRTI_group = recode(
          LRTI_adjudication,
          "Definite" = "LRTI",
          "No Evidence" = "Control"
        )
      ),
    by = "sample_name"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    protein_mat %>%
      { colnames(.)[1] <- "patient_id"; . } %>%
      mutate(
        patient_id = as.integer(patient_id)
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = -patient_id,
        names_to = "gene_symbol",
        values_to = "expr_protein"
      ) %>%
      filter(
        gene_symbol %in% shared_genes
      ),
    by = c(
      "patient_id",
      "gene_symbol"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    gene_symbol,
    LRTI_group
  ) %>%
  summarize(
    pearson_r = cor(
      expr_rna,
      expr_protein,
      method = "pearson",
      use = "complete.obs"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      gene_symbol %in% genes_biomarker ~ "Biomarker",
      gene_symbol %in% genes_lasso ~ "LASSO-selected",
      TRUE ~ "Background"
    ),
    LRTI_group = factor(
      LRTI_group,
      levels = c(
        "LRTI",
        "Control"
      )
    )
  )


# 13.8 Function for LRTI/Control density plots


plot_density_group <- function(
  data_df,
  group_label,
  fill_color
) {

  median_r <- median(
    data_df$pearson_r,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  ggplot(
    data_df,
    aes(x = pearson_r)
  ) +
    geom_density(
      fill = fill_color,
      alpha = 0.25,
      color = "grey25",
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linetype = "solid",
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = median_r,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.7
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = median_r + 0.03,
      y = Inf,
      label = paste0(
        "Median r = ",
        round(median_r, 3)
      ),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1.5,
      size = 3.5,
      family = plot_font
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(-0.5, 0.9),
      breaks = seq(-0.4, 0.8, 0.2)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "RNA-protein concordance — ",
        group_label
      ),
      x = "Pearson r (RNA vs protein)",
      y = "Density"
    ) +
    theme_classic(
      base_size = plot_font_size,
      base_family = plot_font
    ) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(
        family = plot_font,
        size = plot_font_size
      ),
      axis.text = element_text(
        color = "black"
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(
        face = "plain"
      ),
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "plain",
        size = plot_font_size
      ),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
}


# 13.9 LRTI density plot


p_lrti <- plot_density_group(
  data_df = cor_per_gene_adj %>%
    filter(LRTI_group == "LRTI"),
  group_label = "LRTI",
  fill_color = "red"
)


# 13.10 Control density plot


p_control <- plot_density_group(
  data_df = cor_per_gene_adj %>%
    filter(LRTI_group == "Control"),
  group_label = "Control",
  fill_color = "#0072B2"
)


# 13.11 Display group-specific plots


print(p_lrti)
print(p_control)


# 13.12 Export group-specific plots


ggsave(
  file.path(
    results_dir,
    "correlation_density_LRTI.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_lrti,
  width = plot_width,
  height = plot_height,
  device = cairo_pdf
)

ggsave(
  file.path(
    results_dir,
    "correlation_density_Control.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_control,
  width = plot_width,
  height = plot_height,
  device = cairo_pdf
)






# 13.8 Import RNA/protein differential expression results


rna_res <- read.csv(
  file.path(
    results_dir,
    "DE_limma_results_transcriptome.csv"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = F
)

prot_res <- read.csv(
  file.path(
    "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Prot/results",
    "DA_results_proteomics.csv"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = F
)






# 13.9 Prepare RNA/protein differential expression results


rna_df <- rna_res %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene_symbol,
    log2FC_RNA = log2FoldChange,
    padj_RNA = padj
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(gene_symbol),
    gene_symbol != ""
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    gene_symbol,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

prot_df <- prot_res %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene_symbol = gene,
    log2FC_protein = log2FoldChange,
    padj_protein = padj
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(gene_symbol),
    gene_symbol != ""
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    gene_symbol,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )






# 13.10 Create master shared-analyte dataframe

cor_all_df <- cor_per_gene %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene_symbol,
    r_all = pearson_r
  )

cor_group_df <- cor_per_gene_adj %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene_symbol,
    LRTI_group,
    pearson_r
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = LRTI_group,
    values_from = pearson_r,
    names_prefix = "r_"
  )

shared_analyte_df <- rna_df %>%
  inner_join(
    prot_df,
    by = "gene_symbol"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    cor_all_df,
    by = "gene_symbol"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    cor_group_df,
    by = "gene_symbol"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    delta_r_LRTI_Control = r_LRTI - r_Control
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(abs(delta_r_LRTI_Control))
  )

print(shared_analyte_df)

write.csv(shared_analyte_df,
          file.path(results_dir,
                    "shared_analyte_df.csv"))






```
